Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: Represents a queue ticket in the distribution system.

number.description: The sequential number of the ticket.

type.description: The type of service (Normal or Priority).

status.description: The current status of the ticket.

counter.description: The counter or desk where the ticket is being served.

citizenName.description: The name of the person being called.

calledAt.description: When the ticket was called to a counter.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Global settings for the queue system.

lastNumber.description: The last ticket number issued today.

lastDate.description: The date when the last ticket was issued (YYYY-MM-DD).
